commands.cmd:
check() {
  p=$(command -v "$1") || { echo "not on PATH: $1"; return 1; }
  rp=$(readlink -f "$p") || { echo "unresolvable: $p"; return 1; }
  case "$rp" in
    */tools/"$1"-"$2"/*) echo "resolves: $p -> $rp" ;;
    *) echo "unexpected prefix: $rp"; return 1 ;;
  esac
}
ctl=$(check socraticode-nsr-absent 1.14.0)
crc=$?
res=$(check socraticode 1.14.0)
rc=$?
if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] || [ "$crc" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "SOCRATICODE_RESOLVE_FAIL | $res (exit $rc) | control: $ctl (exit $crc)"
  exit 1
fi
pins=$(python3 -c "import json,glob;c='socraticode';s=[x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id']==c];w=sorted({x['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers',[]) for x in (l.get('winners') or []) if x.get('component_id')==c});a=[t['version'] for t in json.load(open('adoption/pins-linux-x86_64.json'))['tools'] if t['id']==c];print('stack',s,'winner',w,'adoption/pins-linux-x86_64.json',a);raise SystemExit(0 if s==w==a==['1.14.0'] else 1)") || { echo "SOCRATICODE_RESOLVE_FAIL: pin records disagree: $pins"; exit 1; }
if grep -qx -- '-- socraticode --' "$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/installed-versions.txt" 2>/dev/null; then
  ledger="listed"
else
  ledger="not listed"
fi
echo "SOCRATICODE_RESOLVE_OK | $res | $pins"
echo "negative control: the same check for an absent command exits $crc ($ctl) | optional installed-versions.txt ledger: socraticode $ledger"

commands.cmd:
P="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/tools/socraticode-1.14.0"
ls=$(timeout 30 npm ls --global --prefix "$P" --depth=0 2>&1) || { echo "SOCRATICODE_PACKAGE_FAIL: npm ls failed"; printf '%s\n' "$ls" | tail -5; exit 1; }
python3 - "$P" "$ls" <<'PY'
import hashlib, io, json, os, sys, tarfile, urllib.request
prefix, ls = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
pin = [t for t in json.load(open('adoption/pins-linux-x86_64.json'))['tools'] if t['id'] == 'socraticode'][0]
stack = [c for c in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if c['id'] == 'socraticode'][0]
readme = open('recipes/README.md').read()
recipe_line = 'npm install --global --prefix "$STACK_HOME/tools/socraticode-1.14.0" --ignore-scripts socraticode@1.14.0' in readme
data = urllib.request.urlopen(pin['url'], timeout=60).read()
sha = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
root = os.path.join(prefix, 'lib/node_modules/socraticode')
tar = tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data))
members = [m for m in tar.getmembers() if m.isfile()]
same = sum(1 for m in members if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(root, m.name.split('/', 1)[1])) and open(os.path.join(root, m.name.split('/', 1)[1]), 'rb').read() == tar.extractfile(m).read())
pkg = json.load(open(os.path.join(root, 'package.json')))
ok = (sha == pin['sha256'] and pin['version'] == pkg['version'] == stack['version'] == '1.14.0' and members and same == len(members)
      and 'socraticode@1.14.0' in ls and recipe_line and stack['source_pin'] in readme and pin.get('ignore_scripts') is True)
print('SOCRATICODE_PACKAGE_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| package.json', pkg['name'], pkg['version'], '| npm ls: socraticode@1.14.0', 'socraticode@1.14.0' in ls, '| registry tarball at the pin url: sha256 equals adoption/pins-linux-x86_64.json:', sha == pin['sha256'], '| installed package files identical to that tarball:', same, 'of', len(members))
print('recipes/README.md has the exact --ignore-scripts install line:', recipe_line, '| and the stack source_pin', stack['source_pin'] + ':', stack['source_pin'] in readme, '| pin ignore_scripts:', pin.get('ignore_scripts'))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY
